title: Ruleset: save
description: rules/<id>/save.yaml: when the game saves by itself (packages/game/save: AutosaveRules, docs/architecture/save.md). The original never autosaved: every flag false is its behaviour.

on_battle_end.description: Autosave after every battle, won or lost.

on_partner_sleep.description: Autosave when the partner goes to sleep.

on_new_day.description: Autosave on every new day of the game clock.

on_tournament_result.description: Autosave after a tournament or arena result.

on_recruit_join.description: Autosave when a recruit joins the city.

on_key_item.description: Autosave after buying or using a key item.

on_dangerous_area.description: Autosave before entering a known dangerous area.

on_story_progress.description: Autosave when the story moves on (a story trigger is set).

on_partner_reborn.description: Autosave when the partner is reborn from its egg after dying.

coalesce_seconds.description: Requests within this many real seconds of the first make one autosave. At least 1: autosave slots rotate by their time in whole seconds.
